shortDescription: Manage ZFS datasets (filesystems/volumes) via TrueNAS middleware

options.name: comments
options.description: Arbitrary comment or notes for the dataset.

options.name: create_ancestors
options.description: If True, create any missing parent datasets automatically when creating. Under TrueNAS CORE, this option is ignored. However, missing ancestors are not created.

options.name: force_size
options.description: Whether to ignore checks if the volume size is below thresholds. Only valid for type=VOLUME.

options.name: name
options.description: Full name (ZFS path) of the dataset, e.g. "pool/dataset".

options.name: sparse
options.description: Whether to create a sparse volume (if type=VOLUME). Cannot be changed after creation.

options.name: state
options.description: If "present", ensure the dataset is created/updated. If "absent", ensure the dataset is deleted.

options.name: volblocksize
options.description: Volume block size if type=VOLUME, e.g. "64K" or "65536". Only valid at dataset creation time; cannot be changed on an existing volume.

options.name: volsize
options.description:
Size of the volume if type=VOLUME. This can be either an integer, or a string like '640K', '32MB', '10GiB', or '1TB'. Allowable  suffixes are:
"K", "M", "G", "T" (powers of 2),
"KB", "MB", "GB", "TB" (powers of 10),
"KiB", "MiB", "GiB", "TiB" (powers of 2) This is required when creating a volume, but not when updating an existing one.
